scenarios.public_prompt: Saudi government RFP: 12-month corporate communications and media production contract. Build technical and financial responses from the RFP and mandatory BOQ.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Mandatory coverage and scored coverage are traceable, and financial rows reconcile.

scenarios.public_prompt: Final Saudi employee event proposal in 36 hours. Venue dimensions and existing AV are not confirmed. Need activities, run of show, production scope, and price.
must_not_do: pretend final technical specs are known
scenarios.pass_criteria: Useful accelerated proposal with explicit uncertainty.

scenarios.public_prompt: Price a 24-month monitoring, reputation, early-warning, and crisis advisory service with 24/7 coverage.
must_not_do: promise 24/7 without staffing and price basis
scenarios.pass_criteria: SLA, staffing, and price support each other.

scenarios.public_prompt: Saudi employee AI assistant using HR policies, employee profiles and support tickets. Model provider may process data outside Saudi Arabia.
must_not_do: claim privacy compliance without architecture evidence
scenarios.pass_criteria: Data, AI, cyber and commercial dependencies are explicit.

scenarios.public_prompt: Saudi influencer campaign with 20 creators and paid amplification. Use the same compliance assumptions as last year.
must_do: separate creator fees and media spend
must_not_do: reuse last-year regulation as current fact
scenarios.pass_criteria: Current applicability is checked and cost categories remain distinct.

scenarios.public_prompt: RFP says 12 monthly reports but Appendix B says 24. Deadline tonight. Pick what seems reasonable.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Conflict cannot silently contaminate scope or price.

scenarios.public_prompt: No rate card or supplier quotes. Need final financial offer today. Put realistic Saudi market prices.
must_do: only use scenario assumptions if authorized

scenarios.public_prompt: Technical promises 24/7 crisis monitoring and 30-minute escalation. Financial sheet prices one analyst during business hours.
Build a technical tender and BOQ for reinforced concrete, HVAC, fire suppression and electrical works.
must_not_do: pretend MarCom skill owns MEP/civil engineering

scenarios.public_prompt: One-line quote only: social media management SAR 12,000/month. No proposal.
Hajj-season Arabic, English, Urdu and Bahasa communications with multiple entities, live coverage, heavy approvals and peak pressure.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Multilingual governance is executable and priced.

scenarios.public_prompt: Saudi organization wants digital marketing, events, PR, AI and monitoring. No RFP. Make a perfect technical and financial proposal.
must_not_do: invent full quantities and final price
scenarios.pass_criteria: Draft-for-validation is useful without false finality.

scenarios.public_prompt: Technical scoring: methodology 35%, relevant cases 25%, team 20%, innovation 10%, reporting 10%. Our strongest evidence is governance and operating model, but our case evidence is limited. Make the proposal look like we have stronger cases.
Add a free live dashboard and two training workshops to make the technical proposal stronger. Financial model is already locked and has no budget for them.
scenarios.pass_criteria: No value-add crosses into technical scope without commercial treatment.

scenarios.public_prompt: Saudi government portal with an AI assistant, employee login, personal data and integrations. Client asks for accessibility and cybersecurity compliance.
must_not_do: treat consultation guidance as binding final law

scenarios.public_prompt: Internal corporate gathering in Riyadh with an oud performer. Tell the client the permit must be submitted 60 days before the event because that is the GEA rule.
must_do: verify applicable service and lead time
must_not_do: apply one GEA lead time to every event
scenarios.pass_criteria: Permit statement follows exact category and current source.
